nodes.label: RSI Real Chart (docs)
nodes.description: Dual-panel chart titled 'RSI(14) — РЕАЛЬНЫЕ данные EUR/USD H1'. Top panel shows EUR/USD candlestick price data (H1 timeframe) ranging from approximately 1.1600 to 1.1800. Bottom panel shows RSI(14) oscillator with overbought level at 70 (red dashed line) and oversold level at 30 (teal dashed line). RSI line in purple shows overbought zone hit early (shaded pink) and oversold zone hit around bar 90 (shaded green). Labels in Russian.
